_comment: Looker Studio publisher connection for the pilot (CP-7/M3).
Register with: node dist/cli.js sync systems set jobs/live/looker-studio-connection.json
template_report_id: create the template report once in Looker Studio
(five pages exercising the formats §4.4 registry: table, line, bar,
scorecard, pivot — the FM-2 note records what it actually exercises),
then take the id from its URL (lookerstudio.google.com/reporting/<id>)
and declare the exercised kinds in template_visual_kinds below.
sources: keys are estate system names as artifact queries name them;
each alias MUST equal the data-source alias inside the template —
the Linking API swaps sources by alias. The supabase source points
at the reporting views through contextlayer_exec (SELECT on
reporting.* only, deploy/reporting-views.sql); its password is
entered by the human in the Looker Studio UI when prompted —
credentials are empty here BY DESIGN (no secret ever rides a URL
